title: Use the approved editorial typeface everywhere
scope: Send, About subheadings, gallery, public/private visits, administrator pages
why: font-serif resolved to the browser serif instead of bundled Fraunces. The shared serif token now resolves to Fraunces, with the documented display axes and heading weight.
before: Browser serif; thinner, inconsistent editorial hierarchy.
after: Fraunces, weight 600, and the approved optical settings.

title: Give About one centered reading column
why: Unlayered .page-intro CSS overrode max-w-3xl and py-16, leaving a 1600px article with left-aligned text and centered CTAs. A dedicated about-page owner restores a 48rem column and consistent vertical rhythm.
before: Text hugs the left edge of a nearly full-width article.
after: Title, prose and invitation share one centered column.

title: Make small-screen navigation readable
why: At 320px the two navigation labels broke mid-phrase, while the logo shrank below the documented 180px minimum. The narrow header now gives navigation its own row; active routes have an underline and aria-current.
before: Two wrapped labels and a 160px wordmark.
after: Whole labels, 180px wordmark, and 44px link targets.

title: Give mobile controls room to tap and read
scope: Shared buttons/toggles, header/footer links, room tabs, scene toolbar and courtyard navigation
why: Mobile buttons were 32–36px high; courtyard arrows were about 23px, and the sound toolbar squeezed its hint into a narrow right column. Key controls now have 44px targets, room labels are 14px, and the scene hint takes its own row.
before: Tiny courtyard arrows and a split, crowded sound toolbar.
after: 44px controls, larger labels, and a separate hint row.

title: Keep journey states visually truthful
scope: Private journey panel; shared destructive button and switch
why: Native scene button rules overrode shadcn switches, selected filters and destructive actions. Native selectors now exclude data-slot primitives. Destructive buttons use ink on coral (6.65:1), and switches transition only their changing properties with a reduced-motion alternative.
before: “Visible” next to a dark track; end action looks like an ordinary outline button.
after: Checked track is gold; end action is coral with legible ink text.

title: Keep creatures clear of the invitation labels
why: Percentage-based companion positions overlapped the stacked mobile actions. In narrow containers, all untouched creatures now perch above the primary button; user-dragged positions are preserved.
before: Companions sit across the primary and secondary buttons.
after: Three companions perch above the actions; every label is clear.

title: Resolve the unavailable-visit dead end
scope: /visit/:id when no visit snapshot is available
why: The error message said the visit was unavailable while the page still promised “Opening your private journal…”. The contradictory loading line is replaced with a route back to invitations; actual loading retains its status announcement.
before: Unavailable error followed by an indefinite opening message.
after: A clear “Back to invitations” recovery action.
